{"consolidated_memory":"**Memory Blowup Issues in graph/store/adjacency.rs — Six Separate Occasions**

The adjacency store component (graph/store/adjacency.rs) in the graph engine side experienced six distinct memory blowup incidents between March and June 2026. All shared the same signal (resident memory climbing with every batch) but had different triggers, root causes, and fixes. All six used the dense neighbourhood fixture for reproduction.

**OCCASION 1: March 1, 2026 — Missing Composite Index**
- Trigger: Tenants with more than 10,000 distinct keys
- Root cause: Missing composite index on (tenant_id, created_at)
- Result: Reclaimed 72 GB of blob storage
- Fix: Added composite index and backfilled in batches
- PR #1750, branch fix/memory-blowup-1

**OCCASION 2: March 13, 2026 — Off-by-One in Slice Bound**
- Trigger: After client had already retried once
- Root cause: Off-by-one error in slice bound
- Result: Memory settled at 167 MB instead of climbing past 4 GB
- Fix: Corrected the bound and added a property test around it
- PR #4793, branch fix/memory-blowup-2

**OCCASION 3: March 26, 2026 — Serialiser Dropping Unknown Fields**
- Trigger: Deeply nested inputs beyond six levels
- Root cause: Serialiser dropping fields it did not know
- Result: Throughput rose 75 percent, to 953 requests per second
- Fix: Switched to a strict schema that rejects unknown fields
- PR #7580, branch fix/memory-blowup-3

**OCCASION 4: April 13, 2026 — Race in Lazy Initialisation**
- Trigger: Records carrying non-ASCII names
- Root cause: Race condition in lazy initialisation
- Result: 68 duplicate rows a day stopped being written
- Fix: Guarded the init with a double-checked lock
- PR #7646, branch fix/memory-blowup-4

**OCCASION 5: April 20, 2026 — Cache Entry Never Invalidated**
- Trigger: Input list came in empty
- Root cause: A cache entry that was never invalidated on write
- Result: Backlog cleared 39 minutes after the deploy
- Fix: Invalidated the entry inside the write transaction
- PR #7741, branch fix/memory-blowup-5

**OCCASION 6: June 13, 2026 — Connection Pool Exhaustion**
- Trigger: After rolling restart of the fleet
- Root cause: Connection pool exhaustion under burst load
- Result: Cold start dropped 34 percent, to 838 ms
- Fix: Raised the pool ceiling and put a bounded wait queue in front of it
- PR #7850, branch fix/memory-blowup-6

**Cumulative Context:** Same corner of the codebase involved in all fixes. Context and patterns carried over across multiple incidents."}
